description:
Four stories. Four childhood dreams. One sky that brought us together.

Each of us found NASA through a different spark, but we share the same wonder: how far can curiosity take us?

“وَكُلٌّ فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ” — each has an orbit, a place, a purpose.

We blend our passion for astronomy and space physics with AI, coding, data analysis, and design to turn big questions into real impact.

We are not here just to participate; we are here to build with purpose and compete to win—together.
